name: WF-18 KB Ingestion v3 — Versioned RAG Corpus

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.kb_documents
(source_id,source_type,source_uri,language,version,status,content,security_flags,source_role,created_at)
VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,'active',$6::text,$7::jsonb,$8,now())
ON CONFLICT(source_id,version) DO UPDATE SET
status=excluded.status,content=excluded.content,security_flags=excluded.security_flags,
source_role=excluded.source_role
RETURNING id,source_id,version,status,source_role;

INSERT INTO public.kb_chunks(document_id,chunk_index,content,metadata)
SELECT $1, row_number() over () - 1, value,
       jsonb_build_object('source_id',$2,'version',$3,'source_type',$4,'source_role',$5)
FROM jsonb_array_elements_text($6::jsonb) AS value
ON CONFLICT(document_id,chunk_index) DO UPDATE SET content=excluded.content,metadata=excluded.metadata;
